title: merge_intervals returns overlapping intervals for unsorted input
body: `merge_intervals` in `scheduling/intervals.py` is documented to accept intervals in any order and to merge intervals that merely touch, such as `(1, 3)` and `(3, 5)`. Neither works: unsorted input comes back with overlaps, and touching intervals stay separate. The result should always be sorted and disjoint.
